note: 台词为本站根据英文版整理后自行翻译，与中文版游戏内文字不完全相同；反应选项名为暂译。

sources.t: KeenGamer《完美喂鸟时光：全角色答案》（英文）
RaiderKing《喂食白鸦：全角色完美答案》（英文，交叉核对）

lines.q: 到底怎样才算长大成人啊？好像每个人都得跨过一道坎才行。
lines.en: How do you become an adult, anyway? It seems like everyone has to overcome a challenge to do it.

lines.q: 你觉得我的枪术有一天能超过我爸吗？
lines.en: Do you think I'll ever be better with a spear than my dad?

lines.q: 偶尔放松一下也不错吧？
lines.en: It's nice to unwind a little sometimes, huh?

lines.q: 有时候别人好像一眼就能猜到我在想什么。我就那么好懂吗？
lines.en: Sometimes, it's like people can guess what's on my mind. Am I that easy to read?

lines.q: 跟你玩捉迷藏一定很好玩！
lines.en: I bet it'd be fun to play hide-and-seek with you!

lines.q: 我最受不了胆小鬼。不过，总比习惯了胆小要好吧。
lines.en: I can't stand cowardice. But I guess maybe that's better than getting used to it.

lines.q: 鸟的动作好快啊，你看起来什么攻击都躲得开！
lines.en: It's neat how quick birds can move. You look like you could dodge any attack!

lines.q: 有时候会听到好听的鸟叫声，是你在唱吗？
lines.en: I hear pretty birdsong sometimes. Is that you?

lines.q: 不知道从你眼里看出去，世界是什么样子。
lines.en: I wonder what the world looks like through your eyes.

lines.q: 今天最适合钓鱼了！下次要不要跟我一起去？
lines.en: Today's a perfect day for fishing! You wanna come along with me sometime?

lines.q: 静下心来，让它成为幽静的池水，把自己交给寂静。冥想是好事。
lines.en: Still your mind. Let it be a secluded pond. Give yourself to silence. It is good to meditate.

lines.q: 我从你身上感到某种深邃而危险的东西。也许安萨拉能把它揭露出来。
lines.en: I sense in you something profound and menacing. Perhaps Answerer can expose it.

lines.q: 我斩杀过巨鸟。但我觉得和你交手会更有乐趣。
lines.en: I have slain giant birds. Yet I feel I would enjoy battling you even more.

lines.q: 你毫无惧色。这很少见。你很少见。
lines.en: You show no signs of fear. That is unusual. You are unusual.

lines.q: 找不到值得一决的对手。我很渴——不是喉咙，是灵魂。
lines.en: I cannot find a fitting opponent for a duel. I am parched. Not my throat, but my soul.

lines.q: 一头海兽让我漂流到了这片土地。或许这就是命运之手。
lines.en: A sea beast diverted me to this land. Perhaps it was the hand of fate.

lines.q: 我厌恶束缚。你呢？
lines.en: I detest restraints. And you?

lines.q: 我讨厌束缚我的人……他们扼杀快乐，只带来无聊。
lines.en: I dislike those who fetter me… They constrain joy and supply boredom.

lines.q: 我喜欢你的眼睛，像阳光一样明亮。
lines.en: I like your eyes. They are as bright as sunlight.

lines.q: 我摸摸你，你不介意吧？
lines.en: You do not mind if I touch you?

lines.q: 你眼中有一种鸟类少见的坚定决心。
lines.en: There is a firm resolve in your eyes not often seen in birds.

lines.q: 老实说，我不太喜欢虫子。你常吃虫子吗？
lines.en: In truth, I have no fondness for insects. Do you eat them often?

lines.q: 我们自认受尤法斯的恩惠，所以不得不对她抱以应有的敬意。
lines.en: We see ourselves as indebted to Yu Phas, so we cannot help but afford her the proper reverence.

lines.q: 最近总觉得有些疲惫……
lines.en: I find myself somewhat weary of late…

lines.q: 若能让这世界成为我的子民能繁荣生息之地，我便心满意足。
lines.en: If I can make this world a place where my people can thrive, I will consider myself satisfied.

lines.q: 小时候，我总是听着睡前故事和摇篮曲入睡。
lines.en: As a child, I used to fall asleep listening to bedtime stories and lullabies.

lines.q: 我渴望成为让尤法斯与萨拉米斯子民引以为傲的女王。
lines.en: I yearn to be a queen that Yu Phas and the people of Saramis can take pride in.

lines.q: 我的臣下一看到我爱画的素描就皱眉。都怪我这只新手臂。
lines.en: My retainer winces at the sight of the sketches I enjoy drawing. I blame this new arm of mine.

lines.q: 身为达马斯卡之子，要我信任神殿是不可能的。
lines.en: As a child of Damascar, I cannot be expected to place my trust in the temples.

lines.q: 我考虑过拿你来练枪术。你一定躲得开我的攻击吧。
lines.en: I have considered training my spear technique against you. Surely you can avoid my blows.

lines.q: 我常常在想，向神明祈祷到底有没有意义。
lines.en: I often wonder if there's any point in praying to the gods.

lines.q: 最近一直睡不好。听听摇篮曲会不会有用呢？
lines.en: I've been having trouble sleeping. I wonder if hearing a lullaby would help.

lines.q: 弹着弹着，常常就弹回了家乡的曲子。大概是想家了吧。
lines.en: In the middle of playing, I often find I'm returning to songs from back home. I guess I'm nostalgic.

lines.q: 为了达成目的，我愿意不择手段、付出任何牺牲。这样不对吗？
lines.en: I'm willing to use any means, make any sacrifice, to achieve my goal. Is that wrong?

lines.q: 我最受不了蛇。要是这里有蛇，你会帮我赶走吧？
lines.en: I can't stand snakes. If there was a snake here, you would chase it away, right?

lines.q: 鸟很会唱歌对吧？那我弹比维拉琴，你来唱怎么样？
lines.en: Birds are good at singing, aren't they? So how about I play my vihuela and you sing for me?

lines.q: 要是看见我骑马出去，可要飞下来跟我打招呼哦。
lines.en: If you see me on a horse ride, you'd better swoop down and say hello.

lines.q: 被掌声包围的感觉真好。想体验的话，我表演时就飞到我身边来吧。
lines.en: It's nice being showered in applause. If you want to experience it, come fly to me when I'm performing.

lines.q: 下次我做饭你要不要尝尝？人类好像都不爱吃我做的菜，不过鸟的话说不定……
lines.en: The next time I make food, will you try it? Humans don't seem to like my cooking, but maybe a bird…

lines.q: 跳舞的关键是姿势。驼着背，只会跳出可怜兮兮的舞。
lines.en: The key to dancing is posture. Slouch, and you'll only give a pitiful performance.

lines.q: 你去过我的家乡特勒斯吗？那是个富饶又悠闲的伯爵领。
lines.en: Have you ever been to my home in Tellus? It's a wealthy county and has an easiness to it.

lines.q: 你是怎么打理羽毛的？好漂亮啊。
lines.en: How do you take care of your feathers? They're so pretty.

lines.q: 刚才听到有人在背后说我坏话。我该怎么办？
lines.en: I heard someone talking about me behind my back earlier. What should I do about that?

lines.q: 在野外生活一定很可怕吧。要去危险的地方的话，记得叫我！
lines.en: It must be scary to live out in the wild. Please call for me if you're ever going somewhere dangerous!

lines.q: 想见见布克发拉斯吗？你们俩要是能成为朋友就好了！
lines.en: Would you like to meet Bucephalus? It'd be fun if you two were friends!

lines.q: 在天上翱翔的感觉很棒吧？你能飞多高？
lines.en: It feels great to soar in the sky, doesn't it? How high can you fly?

lines.q: 我对自己的战斗能力很有信心。改天让你见识一下！
lines.en: I'm confident in my abilities in battle. I should show you what I can do sometime!

lines.q: 我正努力配得上「白银少女」的名号，有布克发拉斯在，一定没问题！
lines.en: I'm trying to live up to the name of "Silver Maiden," and with Bucephalus, I'm sure that I will!

lines.q: 我偶尔会骑马远行。下次要不要一起去？
lines.en: I go on long rides every now and then. Would you like to come along sometime?

lines.q: 关于父母，我只有幸福的回忆。可一想到他们只活在回忆里，还是会难过。
lines.en: I have nothing but happy memories of my parents. But I do get sad, knowing they live only in memory.

lines.q: 稀罕物能卖高价，所以我喜欢。反正你也不懂这些。
lines.en: Rarities fetch a high price, which is why I like them. Not that you'd know about such things.

lines.q: 你读过《哈斯德鲁巴战记》吗？那些场面保证让你热血沸腾！
lines.en: Have you read the War Chronicle of Hasdrubal? I assure you, its scenes will thrill you to the core!

lines.q: 我年轻时可是个美男子，走到哪儿都被人称赞！
lines.en: I was a fine specimen of a man in my youth. No matter where I went, people sang my praises!

lines.q: 不管失败多少次，只要人还活着，梦想就不会死。很有道理吧？
lines.en: No matter how many times you fail, your dream doesn't die until you do. Good advice, right?

lines.q: 我英明、了不起、潇洒，而且是完美的将军！你完全同意，对吧？
lines.en: I am brilliant, amazing, dashing, and more! And I'm a perfect general! You agree fully, correct?

lines.q: 「悔改」「后悔」「改过」这些词对我来说都很陌生。不过我猜你全都做过吧。
lines.en: Words like "repent," "regret," and "reform" are all strange to me. But I suspect you do all of that.

lines.q: 我讨厌寡淡的饭菜，我要过奢华的生活。你也想要吧？
lines.en: I despise a bland meal. I want a life of luxury. You must want that too, yes?

lines.q: 你迟早会明白，我才是这个时代最伟大的领袖！
lines.en: It's only a matter of time before you realize that I was the best leader of this whole era!

lines.q: 我的眼罩底下藏着和过去有关的秘密。不过不告诉你。哈！
lines.en: I got a secret under my eye patch that relates to my past. I won't tell you about it though. HA!

lines.q: 后辈们一定会超越我们。嗯！我很期待。
lines.en: Future generations will surely surpass us. Hm! I look forward to it.

lines.q: 看得出我很用心打理胡子吗？
lines.en: Is it obvious that I take painstaking care of my beard?

lines.q: 看着你，我有种似曾相识的感觉。你觉得是为什么？
lines.en: Looking at you gives me a sense of déjà vu. Why do you suppose that is?

lines.q: 最近总是陷入阴郁的思绪……
lines.en: Of late, I find myself mired in dismal thoughts…

lines.q: 我说教应该没他们说的那么多吧？是吧？
lines.en: Surely I do not lecture as much as they say. Do I?

lines.q: 少女们听着吟游诗人的歌声，都听得入迷了。
lines.en: As they listened, the lovely maidens were enchanted by the bard's voice.

lines.q: 你相信萨拉米斯会有光明的未来吗？
lines.en: Do you believe a bright future awaits Saramis?

lines.q: 我虽然上了年纪，头脑依然敏锐。你说是吧？
lines.en: I would say I remain sharp despite my age. Wouldn't you agree?

lines.q: 一只自由自在的野鸟，被捉去献给我的女王，会觉得残忍吗？
lines.en: Would a wild and unfettered bird consider it cruel to be captured as a gift for my queen?

lines.q: 职责高于一切。哪怕最后落得离婚的下场。
lines.en: One's duties must take precedence over all else. Even if the end result is divorce.

lines.q: 年纪越大，要发的牢骚就越多。或许我该改改了。
lines.en: The older I get, the more I find to grumble about. Perhaps I should work on that.

lines.q: 你真有韧劲。你要是人的话，我真想把你训练成骑士。
lines.en: You're tenacious. If you were human, I'd want to train you as a knight.

lines.q: 我这个年纪的人大都谈过恋爱，我却只对主君尽忠。不过这样也好，对吧？
lines.en: Most my age have had romantic relationships, I've only had loyalty to my lord. But that's fine, right?

lines.q: 住在基多尼亚时，我教年轻人武艺。要我教你几招吗？
lines.en: When I lived in Cydonia, I tutored youths in combat. Would you like me to teach you some martial arts?

lines.q: 大小姐的心被复仇的念头占满了。要怎样才能让她解脱……
lines.en: Milady's heart is consumed with a desire for revenge. What I would do to free her from it…

lines.q: 为主君效力留下的伤疤都是勋章。我这道很帅气吧？
lines.en: Any scar you get in your lord's service is a badge of honor. Mine is handsome, don't you think?

lines.q: 眼神这么坚定的鸟真少见。
lines.en: It's strange to see a bird with such conviction in its eyes.

lines.q: 假如敌人来袭，你要保护的人就在你身后，你会怎么做？
lines.en: Let's say an enemy attacked while your charge stood behind you. What would you do?

lines.q: 躲藏的那段日子，饭都是我做的。要我给你做点什么吗？
lines.en: When we were in hiding, I did all the cooking. Would you like me to make you something?

lines.q: 打理仪容非常重要。你有好好照顾自己吗？
lines.en: Caring for one's personal appearance is crucial. Are you taking good care of yourself?

lines.q: 总听说有人结婚了……我的理想对象到底在哪儿？我一直在找。
lines.en: I keep hearing about people getting married… Where is my ideal partner? I've been searching.

lines.q: 我旅行了很多年，学会了自娱自乐。想学学怎么打发时间吗？
lines.en: I've traveled for years, so I learned how to amuse myself. Care to learn how to while away the time?

lines.q: 我衣服底下藏着一道可怕的伤疤，是我英勇作战的证明。厉害吧？
lines.en: I have a terrible scar that's hidden by my outfit. It's proof that I fight bravely. Impressive, yes?

lines.q: 我分得出鸟的歌声是不是真的动听。你的歌声够一流吗？
lines.en: I can tell if a bird's singing voice is truly beautiful or not. Is your song of sterling quality?

lines.q: 言行要得体，否则会给主君丢脸。你要是侍奉谁，也要记住这一点。
lines.en: Always conduct yourself well, or it reflects badly on your lord. Keep that in mind if you serve someone.

lines.q: 重视一流的东西，自然就有眼光。而且我可是一流的骑士哦。
lines.en: If you value top quality, you develop an eye for it. And I am a sterling knight, you know.

lines.q: 钱包越来越瘪，肚子也越来越空。干脆在这儿吃点鸟食算了……
lines.en: My pockets are getting emptier, and so is my stomach. Maybe I'll just eat some bird food here…

lines.q: 我曾侍奉一位贵族，但一场可怕的变故让他失势了。真是遗憾……
lines.en: I used to serve a noble. But a terrible incident led to his downfall. Very regrettable…

lines.q: 我的天马口味挑剔，不合格的饲料一脚就踢开。真没规矩。
lines.en: My pegasus has a refined palate and kicks away any food that's not up to par. It's bad behavior.

lines.q: 爱娜特莉亚对我总是很凶。你觉得她是在跟我调情吗？
lines.en: Anatolia's always so hard on me. You think it's her way of flirting with me?

lines.q: 建筑怎么搭的，我看一眼就知道。你呢？
lines.en: I can tell how a building is put together with just a glance. What about you?

lines.q: 我爹妈都不在了，但我不怎么寂寞。我可比谁都强！
lines.en: My parents are gone, but I don't really feel lonely. I'm stronger than anyone, ya know!

lines.q: 饿肚子会让人难过。你要是需要吃的，跟我说一声。
lines.en: Being hungry can make ya sad. You ever need food, you let me know.

lines.q: 村里的人总是饿着肚子。我想让大家想吃就能吃上饭。
lines.en: Everyone in the village is always hungry. I wanna make it so they can all eat whenever they want.

lines.q: 在村里的时候，我们会抓沙虫来吃。下次给你带点！
lines.en: Back in the village, we hunted and ate sandworms. I'll bring you some sometime!

lines.q: 我看得出你对我有兴趣。我长得帅嘛，不怪你！
lines.en: I can tell you're interested in me. I'm a good-lookin' guy, so I can't blame ya!

lines.q: 不是针对你，你看起来不太好吃，全是骨头。我把你留到最后。
lines.en: Nothing personal, but you don't really look that tasty. You're all bones for one thing. I'll save you for last.

lines.q: 跟你说，我挺喜欢你的。要不要加入大刀帮？我很强，会罩着你！
lines.en: Know what? I like you. How about if you join the Dadao Gang? I'm strong, and I'll take care of you!

lines.q: 比起鱼那种空洞无神、什么都映不出的眼睛，我更偏爱鸟的脸。呃！
lines.en: I'm partial to birds' faces, not like fishes', with those soulless eyes. Mirrors reflecting nothing. Gah!

lines.q: 酒能给体验增添色彩，让任何对话都焕发新意！你不这么认为吗？
lines.en: Intoxicants add color to one's experiences, bring out a new side to any conversation! Don't you agree?

lines.q: 我在自然美景环绕的家中长大，每天早上都被鸟鸣唤醒。
lines.en: I grew up in a home surrounded by natural beauty, where I awoke each morning to birdsong.

lines.q: 我来给你朗读家父艾尼阿斯的杰作吧。连你这颗鸟儿的心都能打动！
lines.en: I will read you the masterpiece by my father Aeneus. It's powerful enough to move even your avian heart!

lines.q: 要是有你这样的翅膀，我就能立刻飞到任何想研究的题材那里。想想看！
lines.en: Had I wings like yours, I could fly at once to any research subject I wanted. Imagine it!

lines.q: 可惜你不会说人话。你一定有很多故事可讲。
lines.en: It's too bad you don't speak any human languages. I'm sure you'd have tales to tell.

lines.q: 啊，我太爱城市了。坐着就能看尽喧嚣、混乱与狂欢！
lines.en: Ahh, how I adore the city. You can sit back and witness the bustle, the confusion, the ecstasy!

lines.q: 神殿给了我好多故事灵感！这么说来，神殿真是慷慨的赞助人。
lines.en: Through the temples, I've been given so many story ideas! In that way the temples are a generous patron.

lines.q: 我上一部作品是杰作，但下一部会更好。没错！因为我一直在进步。
lines.en: My last work was a masterpiece, but my next will be even better. Yes! For I am always improving.

lines.q: 每当沉思时，就有个恶魔嘲笑我没有才华。你也听过它的声音吗？
lines.en: In moments of reflection, a demon taunts me, telling me I have no talent. Have you heard its voice too?

lines.q: 你的目光出奇地锐利。这双眼睛在战斗中会是优势。
lines.en: You have a strangely penetrating gaze. Your eyes would be an advantage in battle.

lines.q: 我当神殿的信使跑遍了各地，却从没见过你这样的鸟。
lines.en: I've been all over, doing work as a messenger for a temple. But I've never seen a bird like you until now.

lines.q: 欧露赫露救过我的命。我想报答他是理所当然的吧？
lines.en: Orchel once saved my life. It's only natural that I want to return the favor, right?

lines.q: 我不需要睡床，在哪儿都能休息。你也一样吗？
lines.en: I don't need to sleep on a bed. I can rest anywhere. Is it the same for you?

lines.q: 我会用草药抹肉再烟熏来保存。你喜欢香味浓的食物吗？
lines.en: I know how to preserve meat by applying an herbal rub and smoking it. Do you like fragrant food?

lines.q: 在森林里生存需要身手敏捷。你在树上也很灵活吗？
lines.en: You need agility to survive in forests. I wonder, are you agile when you're in trees?

lines.q: 这些刺青是哈尔·哈里族的标记。我多年前就离开了族人，但它们依然是我的一部分。
lines.en: My tattoos mark me as a member of the Har Hali clan. I left them years ago, but they're still part of me.

lines.q: 毒草会害人，但也能制成药。知识永远是关键。
lines.en: Poisonous plants will harm people, but they can be made into medicine. As always, knowledge is key.

lines.q: 我对现在的生活很满意，不用为我担心。
lines.en: I'm happy with my life now. There's no reason to worry about me.

lines.q: 你信奉巴洛尔吗？我很久以前信过，现在不信了。
lines.en: Do you worship Balor? I used to long ago, but I don't these days.

lines.q: 不知道我妈还好吗。要是能像你一样飞，我就去看她。
lines.en: I hope my mom's doing OK. If I could fly like you, I'd go see her.

lines.q: 肚子饿了就来找我！我偷偷塞给你好吃的鱼！
lines.en: If you're hungry, come find me! I'll slip you some tasty fish!

lines.q: 一个人钓鱼的时候，我喜欢唱歌。只有我、海浪、风和我的歌声。
lines.en: When I'm all by myself fishing, I like to sing. Just me, the waves, the wind, and my voice.

lines.q: 关于大海的一切都是我爸教的。不知道我有没有越来越像他。
lines.en: My dad taught me everything I know about the sea. I wonder if I'm shaping up to be like him.

lines.q: 听说贵族都爱办浮华的派对。派对到底有什么好的？
lines.en: All the nobles like to throw flashy parties, or so I hear. What's so great about parties?

lines.q: 我最讨厌撒谎的人。骗了别人还自己偷着乐，太不应该了。
lines.en: What I hate the most are liars. It's not good to deceive people and then laugh about it to yourself.

lines.q: 爸妈总说我的眼睛很漂亮。你觉得呢？
lines.en: My mom and dad always said I have pretty eyes. What do you think?

lines.q: 有时候鞑古席翁的男人会让我心动，可是……不行！我只有亲爱的！
lines.en: Sometimes the guys in Dagsion turn my head, but… No! Sweetie's the one for me!

lines.q: 说起来，你身上的味道跟别的鸟不一样。别动，让我闻闻！
lines.en: You know, you don't smell like other birds. Hold still. Let me check!

lines.q: 我讨厌被人瞧不起。可是优雅的淑女不能痛揍对手……对吧？
lines.en: I hate being looked down on. But I guess a refined lady can't wallop her foes…can she?

lines.q: 这副伪装我也扮了好一阵子了。算是，嗯，习惯了。
lines.en: I have spent some time with this guise by now. I have, hmm, acclimated to it.

lines.q: 我假扮传教士这么多年，这些单纯的野兽竟从不起疑。真是惊人。
lines.en: I have feigned the role of a missionary for years, yet these simple beasts do not question it. Amazing.

lines.q: 你是最好的那种野兽，没有愚蠢的言语，也没有多余的动作。
lines.en: You are the best kind of beast, no foolish words or wasted actions.

lines.q: 是这片土地奇怪，还是我变奇怪了？我也说不清。
lines.en: Is this land strange, or have I become strange? I find I cannot say.

lines.q: 你多美啊。拿来做我手术刀下的标本正合适，嗯？
lines.en: How beautiful you are. A fine specimen for my scalpel, hmm?

lines.q: 光是看到美的事物，心情就会变好。
lines.en: Simply catching sight of a thing of beauty is enough to lift the spirits.

lines.q: 这片土地的阳光毫不留情。真希望有什么能挡一挡。
lines.en: In this land, the sun's rays are relentless. I wish for something to block them.

lines.q: 鞑古扎的植物让我很感兴趣。我还想观察、描绘更多。
lines.en: The plants of Dagda are of much interest to me. I would observe and sketch many more.

lines.q: 我不适合体力活。适合的人去做就好。这不是显而易见吗？
lines.en: I am ill-suited to physical labor. Those who are should be the ones to do it. Obvious, isn't it?

lines.q: 那么，庆祝自己出生的日子到底有什么意义？我实在不明白。
lines.en: What, then, is the purpose of celebrating the day of one's birth? It escapes me.

lines.q: 你的眼神好温柔，让我觉得很安心……
lines.en: Your eyes are so kind. They make me feel safe…

lines.q: 我会被你吸引，也许是因为你和那个人一样难以捉摸……
lines.en: Maybe the reason I'm drawn to you is because, like that person, you're hard to grasp…

lines.q: 恋爱对我来说一直有点难懂。也许有你这样的朋友就够了。
lines.en: Romance has always been a bit tough for me to grasp. Maybe a friend like you is all I need.

lines.q: 啊……对不起……我突然好想哭……
lines.en: Oh… I'm sorry… I suddenly feel like crying…

lines.q: 爱真是奇妙的东西……你有没有喜欢过谁？
lines.en: Love is a strange thing… Have you ever had feelings for someone?

lines.q: 有时候读诗，简直就像在听音乐一样。
lines.en: Sometimes when I read poetry, I swear it's almost like I'm listening to music.

lines.q: 你要是受了伤就来找我，我帮你治疗。
lines.en: If you're ever hurt, come find me, and I'll heal you.

lines.q: 战争与痛苦，争斗与仇恨……这些都只让我难过……能避开的话我想避开。
lines.en: War and pain, fighting and hate… All of it just makes me sad… I'd like to avoid those things if I can.

lines.q: 有时候我满脑子都是心上人……这很正常吧？
lines.en: There are times when I can't take my mind off of the one I adore… That's normal, right?

lines.q: 那个……跟我在一起……不会无聊吗？
lines.en: Um… Doesn't being with me… bore you?

lines.q: 不管被打倒多少次，我老哥都会爬起来。那家伙真有骨气！
lines.en: No matter how hard he gets knocked down, my brother keeps gettin' up. He's got spirit, that guy!

lines.q: 打仗的时候大家都喜欢有我在，平时就不怎么样了。
lines.en: People like having me around in battles, but other than that, usually not.

lines.q: 别坐在我手上，我怕把你捏扁。
lines.en: Don't sit on my hand. I'm worried I might squish you.

lines.q: 呃，杂活真让人火大！有什么办法能让我舒坦点？
lines.en: Ugh, busywork makes me so mad! Is there some way for me to feel better?

lines.q: 喂，要是有人欺负你，跟我说，我把他拧成麻花！
lines.en: Hey, if some bully ever comes at you, you talk to me. I'll twist 'em in knots!

lines.q: 我头好晕……别人一讲复杂的事，我就头昏。
lines.en: My head's spinning… When people talk about stuff that's complicated, I get dizzy.

lines.q: 我从不偷懒不训练。身体练好了，就没有做不到的事！
lines.en: I never forget to train. If your body's in shape, there's nothing you can't do!

lines.q: 我以前那个部族的族长是个混蛋。你要是见到他就告诉我，我去揍晕他。
lines.en: The chief of my old tribe was a jerk. If you ever see him, let me know, and I'll knock him out.

lines.q: 听说我身上流着巨人的血。哇哈哈，真好笑！
lines.en: They say I got giant's blood. Bwahaha. It's funny!

lines.q: 这么安静，我都困了。你来做点什么让我清醒一下？
lines.en: All this peace and quiet is making me sleepy. How about you do something to wake me up?

lines.q: 你有没有活得痛快？不然活着还有什么意思！
lines.en: Are you living your life to the fullest? If not, why bother being alive at all!

lines.q: 哈！刚才有位姑娘狠狠揍了我一拳。那说明她害羞，对吧？
lines.en: Ha! A lady socked me real hard a little earlier. That just means she was shy, yeah?

lines.q: 「不死的古扎岚」这个外号，是我一道伤疤一道伤疤挣来的。很酷吧？
lines.en: I earned my nickname, Unkillable Guzran, one scar at a time. Pretty cool, right?

lines.q: 我喜欢你这坚决的眼神。喂，你知道不死的古扎岚是靠得住的吧？
lines.en: I like your determined look. Hey, you know you can count on the Unkillable Guzran, right?

lines.q: 我可是这里最老练的佣兵之一！看得出我是身经百战的人吗？
lines.en: I'm one of the most seasoned mercenaries here! Do I have the look of a battle survivor?

lines.q: 很多人能有今天都是托我的福。有个佣兵现在都当上帝国监察官了！
lines.en: Lots of people got to where they are today because of me. One merc is now imperial inspector!

lines.q: 给你个忠告：打仗时一定要自己拿主意。不然肯定会死。
lines.en: My advice: make certain you're the one to make the calls in battle. Otherwise, it's a sure way to die.

lines.q: 其实我的真身是一只鸟。所以我在想，你其实是人吧？
lines.en: The truth is, my true form is that of a bird. So I wonder, are you really a person?

lines.q: 人一辈子能吃的饭就那么多顿。想吃什么就吃什么，对吧？
lines.en: There are only so many meals we can eat in our lifetimes. Best to eat what you want, yeah?

lines.q: 前几天我买了个可爱的首饰盒！可惜太便宜，第二天就坏了。
lines.en: I bought a cute accessory case the other day! But it was cheap, and it broke the next day.

lines.q: 我很擅长手工。也许可以试着用鸟的羽毛做点东西。
lines.en: I'm good at crafts. I ought to try making something with bird feathers, maybe.

lines.q: 我看到魔术师凭空在手上变出一只鸟！我也想试试。你能变小吗？
lines.en: I saw a magician make a bird appear in their hand from nowhere! I want to try it. Can you shrink?

lines.q: 我打仗不如大家厉害，但也许能在别的方面派上用场，对吧？
lines.en: I can't fight as well as everybody else, but I can maybe be useful in other ways, right?

lines.q: 我喜欢做甜点。改天也给你做点甜的吧。
lines.en: I like making sweets. Maybe I could make something sweet for you sometime.

lines.q: 纳西姆以前很照顾我。他人好好。我现在有时还会想起他……
lines.en: Nasshim used to take care of me. He was so nice. I still think about him sometimes…

lines.q: 我在构思下一场表演，要是我们一起变个戏法，大家一定会喜欢。
lines.en: I've been thinking about my next performance, and I think people would love it if we did a trick together.

lines.q: 一想到将来，我总会担心那些自己无能为力的事。
lines.en: When I think about the future, I always end up worrying about stuff I can't do anything about.

lines.q: 不管离开多久，一想到家人和家乡，我就好寂寞。
lines.en: It doesn't matter how long I'm gone, thinking of my family and my hometown makes me feel so lonely.

lines.q: 蔬菜嘛，我觉得味道比卖相重要，你说呢？
lines.en: I think taste is more important than looks when it comes to vegetables, don't you?

lines.q: 一练起弓来我就忘了时间。所以晚上看到我的话，喊我一声！
lines.en: I lose all track of time when I'm practicing with my bow. So if you see me at night, give a holler!

lines.q: 我打仗时会说些吓人的话。就像我被那具可怕遗骸附身的时候那样。
lines.en: When I'm fighting, I'll say some horrifying things. Like I did when I possessed those awful remains.

lines.q: 遇到困难时有家人朋友帮忙真好。要珍惜朋友哦，好吗？
lines.en: It's nice having family and friends to help when you're in trouble. Always treasure your friends, OK?

lines.q: 我以前用弓猎过鸟。哈！想试试能不能飞得比我的箭快吗？
lines.en: I used to hunt birds with my bow. Ha! Want to see if you can outfly one of my arrows?

lines.q: 我这人不太给人留下印象。不过你这么漂亮，一定很让人难忘吧……
lines.en: I don't leave much of an impression on people. But you're so beautiful I bet you do…

lines.q: 要是没有乌戈的弓，不知道我在英雄竞技会上会表现得怎么样……
lines.en: I wonder how I would have fared in the Heroic Games if I didn't have Ugo's bow…

lines.q: 我不太会应付男人。要是有人骚扰我，你能帮帮我吗？
lines.en: I'm not very skilled at dealing with men. Could you help me out if one harasses me?

lines.q: 我们村里的人说话口音都很特别。鸟也有口音或方言吗？
lines.en: Everyone back at my village speaks in a very unique way. Do birds have accents or dialects?

lines.q: 你知道密特拉斯修道会吗？我劝你离他们远点。
lines.en: Do you know the Order of Mithras? I'd suggest that you steer clear of them.

lines.q: 我有点累了。要是睡着了，请见谅。
lines.en: I'm a bit tired. Forgive me if I fall asleep.

lines.q: 要是我说你背后有只毒蜘蛛，你会怎么做？来练习一下。把它赶走……就现在！
lines.en: What would you do if I said there's a venomous spider behind you? Let's practice. Drive it off… now!

lines.q: 你能让周围的气氛变得平静。介意我在这里多待一会儿吗？
lines.en: You bring a sort of calm atmosphere to a place. Mind if I linger here a little longer?

lines.q: 接受自己心甘情愿侍奉的主君给的报酬，你觉得不对吗？
lines.en: Do you think it wrong to accept payment from a lord you're drawn to serve?

lines.q: 其实我脾气没那么坏。不知道你是不是也想更合群一点。
lines.en: I'm not all that ill-tempered, really. I wonder if you'd like to be more sociable too.

lines.q: 你觉得我们需要一个领导者吗？我相信这样的理想，也欢迎你说说看法。
lines.en: Do you think we need someone to lead us? I believe in such an ideal, and I welcome your thoughts on it.

lines.q: 哈，你的脸真有意思，我怎么看都看不腻。
lines.en: Ha, you have an interesting face. I never get tired of seeing it.

lines.q: 我的爱驹罗西南老得很有风度。你见到它时也这么觉得吗？
lines.en: My beloved steed, Rocinan, is aging very well. Do you think that when you see him?

lines.q: 一谈到主君和他们的职责，我就会说太多。是不是该少说点？
lines.en: I end up saying too much when talk turns to lords and their duties. Should I say less about it all?

lines.q: 帮助朋友和弱者是理所当然的。但做正确的事，有时需要勇气。
lines.en: It's natural to help one's friends and also the weak. But it sometimes takes courage to do what's right.

lines.q: 我走遍了这片大地。你也去过很多地方吗？
lines.en: I've traveled all over the land. Have you visited lots of places too?

lines.q: 成天打仗，人会变得很疲惫……
lines.en: When you do nothing but battle, you can end up feeling pretty frazzled…

lines.q: 我有想要守护的东西。你有想守护的东西吗？
lines.en: I have things I want to protect. Is there something that you want to protect?

lines.q: 想活下去，有时就得耍点小聪明。我是说，真的没办法的时候！
lines.en: Sometimes you've got to get sneaky if you want to survive. I mean, when you really have to!

lines.q: 飞的时候被大雨淋到是什么感觉？
lines.en: What's it like if you get hit by heavy rain while you're flying?

lines.q: 深爱着家人，结果一切都分崩离析，没有比这更糟的了，对吧？
lines.en: When you love your family and it all falls apart, that's about as bad as it gets, right?

lines.q: 要在某处安家的话，大家庭还是住大房子最好，对吧？
lines.en: If someone settles down somewhere, a big home is best to house a big family, right?

lines.q: 我有过丈夫。他很早以前就走了，不知道他是不是在守望着我。
lines.en: I had a husband, you know. He died some time ago, but I wonder if he watches over me.

lines.q: 我不把钱看得比别的东西重。可是有些东西没有钱就守不住，不是吗？
lines.en: I don't value money over other things. But aren't there things you can't protect without money?

lines.q: 你好像总是独自一个。一个人在外面，不寂寞吗？
lines.en: You always seem to be alone. Don't you get lonely out there in the world, all by yourself?

lines.q: 我不能引人怀疑。你停在我手腕上，我会不会更像个小丑？
lines.en: I can't arouse suspicion. Will I look more like a clown if you're perched on my wrist?

lines.q: 啊，把疯劲儿释放出来之后我感觉好极了！你呢？
lines.en: Ahh, I'm feeling great since I got to let my freak loose! How 'bout you?

lines.q: 这身戏服是我自己做的。当地狱小丑的制服挺不错吧？
lines.en: Made this costume myself. Pretty good uniform for the Infernal Clown, don't ya think?

lines.q: 化妆真好。能遮住你的血、你的泪……还有你的罪。你也想化一化吗？
lines.en: Makeup's great. It hides your blood, your tears… your crimes. You wanna get made up?

lines.q: 呃。糟心的故事太多了。我要睡了，你帮我放哨。
lines.en: Guuh. Too many nasty stories. I'm gonna sleep, keep an eye out.

lines.q: 呃，我最讨厌趾高气扬的人。真想把他们的肠子扯出来！
lines.en: Guh, there's nothing I hate more than people who act high and mighty. I wanna yank out their guts!

lines.q: 想换个造型吗？用小鸟的血染个色怎么样？嘿嘿嘿！
lines.en: Lookin' for a new look? How about a little birdie-blood dye job? Heh heh heh!

lines.q: 贝特兰太一本正经了！那家伙几乎开不起玩笑。你知道这对我来说有多难熬吗？
lines.en: Bertrand's so serious! The guy hardly ever takes a joke. Y'know how hard that is for me?

lines.q: 鸟真好。一眨眼就能飞到凶案现场！嘿嘿嘿！
lines.en: Birds, you're so lucky. In a flash, you can fly out to murder scenes! Heh heh heh!

lines.q: 好累，累得像生病了一样。我好消沉……受不了了！
lines.en: I'm tired, almost like I'm sick. I'm at such a low point… I can't take it!

lines.q: 自从看到被我杀掉的人的亡魂，我就经常祈祷。你要是看到了也祈祷吧。
lines.en: I've been praying a lot ever since I've been seeing ghosts of those I killed. You pray too if you see 'em.

lines.q: 以前的手下都很爱戴我。希望他们过得好。你觉得他们会再跟我干吗？
lines.en: My old crew used to love me. I hope they're doing alright. You think they'll join up with me again?

lines.q: 你该加入我的黑天鹅海盗团。跟你说，没有比当海盗更快活的了！
lines.en: You should join my Black-Swan Pirates. I tell you, there's nothing more fun than life as a pirate!

lines.q: 密特拉斯修道会烂到根了。他们比海盗危险多了。
lines.en: The Order of Mithras is rotten to the core. They're far more dangerous than pirates.

lines.q: 那个蠢货弄沉了我的船，可在梦里它依然好好地航行着。真是艘美丽的船！
lines.en: That fool sank my ship, but I still see it sailing right and fine in my dreams. A beautiful vessel!

lines.q: 我是大鹏，你是小鸟。所以要是我被人追，你会帮朋友一把吧？
lines.en: I'm the Rukh, and you're a little bird. So you'll help a friend out if I'm chased down, right?

lines.q: 要是看到鬼，你会怎么办？说实话，我会直接吓晕。很窝囊吧……
lines.en: What would you do if you saw a ghost? Truth be told, I just faint dead away. Pathetic, I know…

lines.q: 等我把手下召集齐了，我发誓不害人，只寻宝。你要跟我一起去吗？
lines.en: When I get my crew together, I swear I'll do no harm, only look for treasure. Would you come with me?

lines.q: 你认识一个叫谭利穆恩的王族混蛋吗？见到他就啄他的眼睛，好吗？
lines.en: You know a royal jerk who goes by Talimun? Peck out his eyes if you see him, alright?

lines.q: 人家说我是传奇海盗德雷克的继承人。他的藏身处全归我了。了不起吧？
lines.en: They say I'm successor to the legendary pirate Drake. His hideout was all mine. Incredible, right?

lines.q: 你喜欢亮晶晶的东西吗？想看看我的宝石吗？
lines.en: Do you like sparkly things? Wanna see my gems?

lines.q: 我喜欢把存款数了又数，感觉离梦想更近了。
lines.en: I like counting my savings over and over. Makes me feel like I'm getting closer to my dream.

lines.q: 我去打猎的时候得小心别误射到你。
lines.en: I'll have to be careful not to shoot you by mistake when I go hunting.

lines.q: 下次去打猎，我给你带点回来。
lines.en: Next time I go hunting, I'll bring back some for you.

lines.q: 唉……真希望有一天全家人能像以前一样住在一起。
lines.en: Urgh… I wish the day would come that my whole family could live together like we used to.

lines.q: 想到要怎么花这些存下的钱……那一天一定很美好。
lines.en: When I think about what I'll do with all this money I've saved… that's gonna be a great day.

lines.q: 一直不停地工作，偶尔喘口气真的很管用。
lines.en: When I've been working nonstop, sometimes a breather does me a world of good.

lines.q: 给不信任你的人干活也不算太糟，至少钱不错。
lines.en: Working for someone who doesn't trust you isn't too bad. The money's nice, at least.

lines.q: 说钱比信任更重要，会不会太冷血了？
lines.en: Would it be coldhearted of me to say that money's more important to me than trust?

lines.q: 你的翅膀好漂亮，让我好好看看。
lines.en: Your wings are so pretty. Let me get a better look.

lines.q: 鸟吃鱼对吧？改天我给你抓条大的！
lines.en: Birds eat fish, right? I'll catch a big one for you sometime!

lines.q: 我不知道爸妈是谁，不过无所谓。现在过得好就行。
lines.en: I don't know who my parents are, but I don't really care. Things are good now. That's what matters.

lines.q: 神殿里有个讨厌的家伙。他要是再欺负我，我就揍他。
lines.en: There's a horrible guy who I know from my temple. I'm going to punch him if he treats me badly again.

lines.q: 给神殿干活之前我偷过东西。被抓到就会挨罚，现在还留着伤疤呢。要看吗？
lines.en: I stole things before I worked for the temple. I'd get punished if caught and still have a scar. Wanna see?

lines.q: 就算有点无聊，只要有地方睡、有饭吃，我就没什么好抱怨的。
lines.en: Even if it gets kinda boring, I can't complain if I've got a place to sleep and enough to eat.

lines.q: 你住在森林里对吧？那你说说……你怎么看鬼魂？
lines.en: You live in the forest, right? So tell me… how do you feel about ghosts?

lines.q: 学用刀总比坐在教室里念书强。我说得对……对吧？
lines.en: It's better to learn how to use a blade than sit around in a classroom learning stuff. I'm right… right?

lines.q: 我最爱甜食了。改天给你带我最喜欢的怎么样？
lines.en: I love sweets. How about I bring you my favorites sometime?

lines.q: 欧辛教了我防身术。我想变得更强，让他不用再担心我！
lines.en: Ozin taught me how to defend myself. Now I want to be strong enough, so he doesn't have to worry!

lines.q: 我现在过得挺开心的。但我很挂念以前一起流浪街头的孤儿朋友们……
lines.en: I'm pretty happy with my life now. But my heart goes out to my ol' street-orphan friends…

lines.q: 丹提的作品太棒了！来，我念一段给你听！
lines.en: Dante's work is amazing! Here, let me read you something!

lines.q: 父亲总说我是出色的剑士。不过用斧头就从来没让他满意过……
lines.en: Father always said I was a fantastic swordsman. Couldn't ever impress him with axes, though…

lines.q: 我在商会拼命干活。呼！我觉得我需要休个假。
lines.en: I've been working so hard at the company. Whew! I think I need a vacation.

lines.q: 其实我自己也写点东西。应该写一篇以你为主角的故事。
lines.en: You know, I do a little bit of writing myself. I should write something with you as the main character.

lines.q: 前几天看到一对情侣，好热烈啊！有点让人羡慕。
lines.en: I saw this couple the other day, and they had so much passion! Kinda made me jealous.

lines.q: 要是我有翅膀？我要周游世界，看遍这一生能看的一切。
lines.en: If I had wings? I'd travel the world and see everything this life has to offer.

lines.q: 呃！黏糊糊、油腻腻的……我最讨厌脏东西了。
lines.en: Ugh! Gummy, sticky, greasy… I just hate dirty things.

lines.q: 总有一天，我想当一场伟大冒险的主角。你要跟我一起去吗？
lines.en: One day, I'd love to be the main character of some grand adventure. Would you want to come with me?

lines.q: 呜呜。原来我喜欢的人已经有对象了……我该怎么振作起来……
lines.en: Ugggh. Turns out, the person I like already has a partner… How will I ever recover…

lines.q: 作为一只鸟你真聪明。你不会是故事里那种化身成鸟的精灵吧？！
lines.en: You're pretty smart for a bird. Are you one of those spirits in disguise like in the stories?!

lines.q: 我是不是太严肃了？有时候别人的反应像是被我唠叨了一样。
lines.en: Am I too serious? Sometimes people react to me as if I was nagging them.

lines.q: 和你在一起让我好安心，真想把你装进笼子里走到哪带到哪。
lines.en: Being with you puts me at such ease that I wish I could cage you to take you wherever I go.

lines.q: 就算别人抱怨，我也完全有权拒绝喝酒。我酒量不好。
lines.en: Despite the complaints, I have every right to refuse a night's drinking. I don't tolerate alcohol well.

lines.q: 和你一起在云间飞翔，一定很美妙。
lines.en: I bet it would feel incredible to fly alongside you in the clouds.

lines.q: 我喜欢仰望天空。这没什么傻的……对吧？
lines.en: I like gazing at the sky. There's nothing silly about that… right?

lines.q: 我必须努力超越父亲，才能和那些勇敢的老兵并肩！
lines.en: I must strive to surpass my father, so I can stand shoulder to shoulder with the brave veterans!

lines.q: 有时候我会为自己的经验不足感到懊恼……
lines.en: I sometimes find my own inexperience frustrating…

lines.q: 我在考虑要不要硬着头皮回家一趟。我和继父处得不太好。
lines.en: I'm considering if I should force myself to visit home. My stepfather and I don't get along very well.

lines.q: 看着你，就像仰望天空时的感觉一样。
lines.en: To look at you gives me the same feeling as when I gaze up at the sky.

lines.q: 拒绝热情女性的示好，身心都很疲惫……
lines.en: Turning down the advances of passionate women wears on me, mentally and physically…

lines.q: 要是我南十字兵团的人参加了竞技会，我们肯定会赢，对吧？
lines.en: If my Southern Cross Brigade crew had battled in the games, we would have won, right?

lines.q: 该死的密特拉斯修道会把我丢下等死。伟大的马吉迪岂是他们能抛弃的！
lines.en: That damned Order of Mithras left me for dead. They can't abandon the great Majide!

lines.q: 无聊死了。有什么好招给我看看？
lines.en: I'm bored as hell. Got a good move to show me?

lines.q: 你不怕我，说明你不懂我有多厉害。要我露一手吗？
lines.en: You're not scared of me, which means you don't get how great I am. How about I show you?

lines.q: 心烦的时候，没有比揍无名小卒更爽的了。你心烦时会做什么？
lines.en: Nothin' better than smacking around nobodies when I'm annoyed. What do you do when you are?

lines.q: 我狠狠推了个嘴贱的醉鬼。得承认，挺爽的。不过现在该睡一觉了。
lines.en: I shoved a mouthy drunk real hard. Felt pretty good, I gotta admit. But now it's time I catch some z's.

lines.q: 谁都知道伟大的马吉迪力抵十人。要我给你砸几块石头看看吗？
lines.en: Everyone knows the great Majide has the strength of 10 men. How about I smash some rocks for you?

lines.q: 这里这些杂兵没一个打得过我。他们干嘛还要试？
lines.en: None of these grunts around here have a chance of beating me. Why do they even try?

lines.q: 牢房就是我的第二个家。下次我被关起来，来找我，我们玩个游戏！
lines.en: Prison cells are my home away from home. Next time I'm locked up, find me and we'll play a game!

lines.q: 不管谁来挑战，都不是伟大的马吉迪的对手，对吧？
lines.en: Doesn't matter who comes at me, they're no match for the great Majide, right?

lines.q: 妈妈的婚姻失败了，不代表女儿也会犯同样的错。对吧？
lines.en: Just because a mom's marriage failed doesn't mean her daughter will make the same mistake. Right?

lines.q: 我唱歌不太好。我喜欢唱，可是总跑调。
lines.en: I'm not the best singer. I enjoy it, but I can't carry a tune.

lines.q: 要是酒馆里有个家伙闹事，我得一拳揍晕他。是不是该避开脸？
lines.en: Say there's a guy in the tavern causing a fuss and I need to punch him out. Should I avoid the face?

lines.q: 我姐姐教我做饭。她超厉害的。尝一口心都要飞起来了。
lines.en: My sister taught me how to cook. She's incredible. One taste and your heart just soars.

lines.q: 不知道你这身子里有多大力气。要不我轻轻捏一下试试？
lines.en: I wonder how much strength is in that body. Maybe I should just give you a little squeeze.

lines.q: 欠债可不好。只要债还压在身上，就没法好好思考。
lines.en: Owing debts is no good. As long as they're hanging over you, you can't think straight.

lines.q: 钱是苦难的根源。不过你不用担心这个！
lines.en: Money is the root of hardship. Not that you need to worry about that!

lines.q: 在外面要小心。看到可疑的人就赶紧飞走！
lines.en: Be careful out there. If you see someone suspicious, just fly off, quick as you can!

lines.q: 变强是好事。这样到了该把没用的丈夫踢出门的时候，你就准备好了！
lines.en: It's good to get strong. That way you're ready when it's time to kick out your good-for-nothing husband!

lines.q: 你有重要的人吗？希望有。要尽你所能保护他们。
lines.en: Do you have someone dear to you? I hope so. Do whatever you can to protect them.

lines.q: 不知道我爸现在在哪儿。希望他有好好吃饭什么的。
lines.en: I don't know where my dad is now. Hope he's eating and stuff.

lines.q: 我很懂药草。你要是受伤了，我帮你治！
lines.en: I'm pretty knowledgeable about medicinal herbs. If you ever get injured, I'll fix you up!

lines.q: 我妈很爱唱歌，可是唱得超难听。你看起来很会唱，对吧？
lines.en: My mom loves singing, and she's AWFUL at it. You seem like a good singer, though, right?

lines.q: 西洛可人很好，我只是真希望他别整天拈花惹草。
lines.en: Sirocco's so great, I just really wish he didn't spend all his time womanizing.

lines.q: 改天要不要尝尝我做的菜？别人都不肯吃。
lines.en: Wanna try my cooking sometime? No one else will eat it.

lines.q: 你的眼神很温柔，看着就让我心情变好。
lines.en: You have kind eyes. Looking at them really makes me feel better.

lines.q: 大家都把我当小孩子。不知道这会不会有改变的一天。
lines.en: Everyone treats me like a kid. I wonder if that'll ever change.

lines.q: 我本来觉得自己和妈妈没什么共同点，不过我这爱逞强的性子也许就是遗传她的。
lines.en: I didn't think I had much in common with my mom, but maybe she's where I got my pushiness.

lines.q: 我想帮助有困难的人。可我得变得更强才行！
lines.en: I want to help people when they're in trouble. But I gotta get way stronger to do that!

lines.q: 以前妈妈还在家的时候会训练我！你要试试吗？
lines.en: Back when Mom still lived at home, she'd train me! Wanna give that a shot?

lines.q: 你的眼睛好怪。说起来，有点像爱娜特莉亚的。
lines.en: You've got weird eyes. Ya know, they kinda remind me of Anatolia's.

lines.q: 在村里，能弄到什么就吃什么，连虫子也吃。在那儿你可算是美味了。
lines.en: We ate what we could get in the village. Even bugs. Back there, you woulda been a delicacy.

lines.q: 看到有人有困难，就该帮一把。就这么简单！
lines.en: If you see someone in trouble, you should help them. It's that simple!

lines.q: 村里的人对我很好，所以我想让他们开心。
lines.en: The people of the village were real nice to me, so I wanna try and make them happy.

lines.q: 武艺能磨砺心志、强健体魄。你也试试吧！
lines.en: Martial arts tightens my mind and strengthens my body. You should give it a try too!

lines.q: 大家总吼我让我安静点。我真的那么吵吗？
lines.en: Everybody's always yelling at me to be quiet. Am I really that loud?

lines.q: 是不是练得太投入了？我现在好困。
lines.en: Maybe I got a little too into my training? I'm sleepy now.

lines.q: 就因为我个子矮，大家都把我当小孩。以貌取人可不好，你知道吧？
lines.en: Everybody treats me like a kid just 'cause I'm short. It's no good to judge folks on appearances, ya know?

lines.q: 望着云朵总能抚慰我受伤的心。你愿意陪我一起看吗？
lines.en: Looking at the clouds always is a balm for my hurt and heart. Would you join me, looking?

lines.q: 我一看向别人，他们就移开视线。看来我永远都被人畏惧。
lines.en: When I look at someone, they in turn look away. It seems that I'm forever feared.

lines.q: 我喜欢独处。你也是吗？
lines.en: I like being alone in my solitude. Do you too?

lines.q: 精灵们想和你说话。它们……对你很好奇。
lines.en: The spirits want to talk to you. They're… curious about you.

lines.q: 是啊，真的……很有趣呢……咦，你看不见我在和谁说话吗？
lines.en: Yes, truly… It is wonderful fun, isn't it… What, can't you see who I'm speaking with?

lines.q: 我非常讨厌虫子。有虫子靠近我的话，你能帮我赶走吗？
lines.en: I have a strong dislike for insects. Could you chase off any who draw too close to me?

lines.q: 我的话似乎总会被人听成奇怪的意思。我被误解……又被疏远。
lines.en: I fear that my words enter the ear in strange ways. I am misunderstood… and avoided.

lines.q: 死亡萦绕着我。你也被死亡萦绕吗？
lines.en: Death haunts me. Are you haunted by death?

lines.q: 若你愿意和我一起祈祷，让迷途的灵魂前往彼岸，我会很感激。
lines.en: I would be grateful if you would pray with me, that wayward souls may move on to the next world.

lines.q: 在家乡我没什么地位，可因为是族长的女儿，总被挑出来接受求婚挑战。你能理解我为什么讨厌那里了吧？
lines.en: Back home, I don't rank that high in importance, but as the chief's daughter, I'm singled out for marital challenges. Can you see why I hate it back there?

lines.q: 我从小被教导，得嫁给在公平决斗中打败自己的人。这传统很蠢吧？反正我比家乡那些男人都强。
lines.en: I grew up thinking you had to marry the person who can defeat you in a fair fight. It's a dumb tradition, right? I'm tougher than the guys back home anyway.

lines.q: 住在山上让我学会了很多，比如打猎和打铁。有本事总是好的，对吧？
lines.en: I learned a lot living on a mountain, like hunting and blacksmithing. Good to have skills, right?

lines.q: 我喜欢用拳头战斗，打起来自由又灵活。懂我的意思吗？
lines.en: I like fighting with my fists. Keeps me feeling free and nimble in battle. Get what I mean?

lines.q: 我这辈子大多数日子都在奥尔格斯山上上下下地训练。要我把你的栖木踢成两半吗？
lines.en: I trained most days of my life, going up and down Mount Orgus. Want me to kick your perch in half?

lines.q: 我想给我的摔跤舞加个新动作。有什么好点子吗？
lines.en: I want to add a new move to my wrestle-dancing. Have any great ideas?

lines.q: 我想给你取个比「鸟」更好的名字。叫「鸟鸟」怎么样？不行，不太对。有什么建议吗？
lines.en: I'd like to call you something more than "bird." How's Birdlee? Nah, that's not right. Any advice?

lines.q: 我三哥也和我一样在周游世界。要是见到他就打个招呼，他很喜欢动物。
lines.en: My third eldest brother is traveling the world like I am. Say hello if you see him. He loves animals.

lines.q: 很快就会有好事发生。我的直觉一向很准！
lines.en: Something good is coming up soon. My gut is always right, you know!

lines.q: 你总是一个人在这儿。离开鸟群了吗？我也做过类似的事。我们做朋友吧！
lines.en: You're always here alone. Did you leave your flock? I did something like that too. Let's be friends!

lines.q: 城市生活对我这个森林子民来说还是很陌生。要是我在鞑古席翁迷路了，你能给我带路吗？
lines.en: City life is still strange to a forest-dweller like me. If I get lost in Dagsion, would you show me the way?

lines.q: 鸟一天要吃好几顿，对吧？希望你吃得饱饱的，飞得有力。
lines.en: Birds have many meals each day, yes? I hope you eat well and fly vigorously.

lines.q: 我们哈尔·哈里族与自然和谐共处。你不是我结交的第一只鸟。
lines.en: We of the Har Hali live in harmony with nature. You are not the first bird I would befriend.

lines.q: 嗯。羽毛这么乱，飞起来一定很费劲。我帮你理顺。
lines.en: Hm. These disheveled feathers must make it hard to fly. I'll straighten them for you.

lines.q: 我想没有人能玷污你的翅膀。坚守你的生活方式，别让任何人把你关起来。
lines.en: I suspect no one could tarnish your wings. Keep true to your way of life. Let no one take you captive.

lines.q: 我的本事比不上历代族长。我对族人到底有没有用处？
lines.en: My skills did not live up to those of previous chiefs. Have I been of use to my people at all?

lines.q: 我们的毒箭只要擦到一下，鸟就会当场倒下。我们打猎时你离远点。
lines.en: A mere graze from our poison arrows can fell a bird instantly. Stay well away during our hunts.

lines.q: 我的族人用动物的举动来占卜战事。姿态勇猛是吉兆。
lines.en: My people use the behavior of animals as an omen for battle. A bold attitude is a good omen.

lines.q: 只靠力量统治只会让人民窒息。你在压迫之下一定也会喘不过气吧。
lines.en: Rule based on strength only chokes the people. I'm sure you would also feel suffocated under oppression.

lines.q: 不能因为骄傲而自我孤立。那是死路一条。别忘了这一点。
lines.en: We must not isolate ourselves out of pride. That way is death. Do not forget this.

lines.q: 佣兵挑活儿比大家想的要挑剔。别人不明白这一点。
lines.en: Mercenaries are more selective about work than you'd think. People don't understand that.

lines.q: 想成长，就得什么都学一点。从你的动作里我能学到什么呢？
lines.en: You have to learn a little bit about everything to grow. What can I learn from your movements?

lines.q: 我下了很大功夫学读书写字。你觉得你也能学会吗？
lines.en: I studied hard to learn how to read and write. Do you think you could do that too?

lines.q: 离开王国后，我学了写字，触犯了那里的律法。尤法斯一定会惩罚我吧。
lines.en: After I left my kingdom, I broke one of its laws by learning to write. Yu Phas will surely punish me.

lines.q: 别担心，我没兴趣猎你。我连肉都不爱吃。
lines.en: Don't worry. I have no interest in hunting you. I don't even like meat.

lines.q: 很多人依赖我，但老实说，要是我也能多依赖别人就好了。
lines.en: People rely on me a lot, but I have to admit it'd be nice if I could rely on others more.

lines.q: 我喜欢吃甜的。大家都很意外。可这真有那么出人意料吗？
lines.en: I like eating sweet things. That surprises people. But is that really so unexpected?

lines.q: 我离开了王国，但萨拉米斯仍有许多人敬仰我。我很感激。
lines.en: I left my kingdom behind, but there are still many in Saramis who look up to me. I'm grateful.

lines.q: 我曾被誉为「凯卢斯的蓝玫瑰」。想听我演奏吗？
lines.en: I was recognized as the Blue Rose of Caelus. Would you like to hear me play?

lines.q: 我发誓总有一天要胜过蕾莉达娜。希望你为我加油！
lines.en: I will best Leilidahna one day, I swear it. And I hope you'll cheer me on!

lines.q: 卡拉大人太美了！我想你第一眼就会爱上她。
lines.en: Kalla is so lovely! I imagine you'd fall in love with her at first sight.

lines.q: 无论音乐还是舞蹈，一天不练就会退步。千万别荒废练习！
lines.en: In either music or dance, one missed day of practice costs you some skill. Never neglect your studies!

lines.q: 哎呀，手工又做砸了。我真不明白自己的艺术天分怎么就不灵了。
lines.en: Oh dear, my handicraft turned out poorly again. I understand not why my artistic talent is failing me.

lines.q: 听别人演奏时，有时能感受到对方的情绪。你也会这样吗？
lines.en: Listening to music played by another, I can sometimes feel their emotions. Do you share this?

lines.q: 我对自己的歌喉最有信心了。你呢？
lines.en: I have the greatest confidence in my singing. And yourself?

lines.q: 要我为你写首诗吗？要写的话，我会尽全力让你满意……
lines.en: Shall I compose a poem about you? If so, I'll do all I can to make sure it pleases you…

lines.q: 当母亲是什么感觉呢？一想到就觉得好可怕。
lines.en: What must motherhood be like? I can't help but find the prospect terrifying.

lines.q: 开花的树即使老了也照样开花。这证明年龄不该阻碍追求！同意吧？
lines.en: Flowering trees bloom even as they get old. It proves that age should not impede one's pursuits! Agreed?

lines.q: 这里的人一天比一天更爱戴朕。这就是王者对他人的影响吗？
lines.en: More of the people here grow to love us by the day. Is this the effect kings have on others?

lines.q: 朕此刻有些无聊。你会表演什么把戏吗？
lines.en: We find ourselves bored at the moment. Can you perform any tricks?

lines.q: 朕自幼便爱吃海鲜，想与你一同品尝鞑古扎的特产。
lines.en: We have enjoyed seafood since our earliest days and would like to savor Dagdan specialties with you.

lines.q: 朕来自热爱自然的布丽吉德王国，所以和你在一起很愉快。
lines.en: We are from Brigid, which is a kingdom that loves nature. So we enjoy our time with you.

lines.q: 朕认为你值得朕庇护，若你遇到麻烦，就交给朕吧。
lines.en: We deem you worthy of our protection, so if you're ever in trouble, please let us handle it.

lines.q: 你一定要来朕的王国。朕会隆重地款待你！
lines.en: You must visit our kingdom. We would feed and entertain you magnificently!

lines.q: 朕非常喜爱布丽吉德的子民。若你见到，务必告诉朕，好吗？
lines.en: We are very fond of the people of Brigid. So if you see any, please tell us, alright?

lines.q: 你让朕想起故乡的精灵。也许我们之间有某种联系。
lines.en: You remind us of the spirits of our homeland. Perhaps we are connected somehow.

lines.q: 要了解异国的风俗，没有比和当地人打成一片更好的办法了，对吧？
lines.en: To learn the ways of a foreign land, there's no better way than to mingle with its people, right?

lines.q: 我真不知道该拿对媞雅拉的这份感情怎么办。
lines.en: I just don't know what to do about these feelings I have for Tialla.

lines.q: 大家都在战斗。虽然害怕，但我会尽力的！
lines.en: Everyone's fighting. It's scary, but I'm doing my best!

lines.q: 怕到腿发抖、动都动不了的时候，该怎么办？
lines.en: What should I do when I get so scared my legs start shaking and I can't move?

lines.q: 有些动物总是吵吵闹闹的。你不会那样吧？
lines.en: Some animals make all kinds of racket. But you don't do that, do you?

lines.q: 附近有棵金吉树。我们一起去摘果子吧！
lines.en: There's a ginji tree not far from here. We should go together and pick some of the fruit!

lines.q: 我梦见了一只美丽的鸟……不知道是不是你的朋友。
lines.en: I had a dream about a beautiful bird… I wonder if it was a friend of yours.

lines.q: 我喜欢云。它们好大，能变出各种形状，好有意思。
lines.en: I like clouds. They're so big, and it's neat to see all the shapes they can take.

lines.q: 一放松就想睡……喂，我要是睡着了，你会叫醒我吗？
lines.en: Taking it easy makes me sleepy… Hey, if I fall asleep, will you wake me up?

lines.q: 在森林里散步，听着各种动物的叫声，很舒服吧？
lines.en: It's nice to walk around the forest and listen to all the sounds the animals make, huh?

lines.q: 看着你……就觉得人生再难的事我也能面对。
lines.en: I look at you and… You make me feel like I can face even the most difficult things in life.

lines.q: 我喜欢写寓言。鸟类之间有流传的故事吗？我很想听听。
lines.en: I enjoy writing fables. Are there any tales shared among birds? I'd love to hear them.

lines.q: 要一起去钓鱼吗？悠闲地抛着鱼线打发时间很惬意。
lines.en: Care to join me fishing? It's nice to spend time idly, casting a fishing line.

lines.q: 我喜欢帮助那些已经在努力自救的人。这算爱管闲事吗？
lines.en: I like lending a hand to those already trying to help themselves. Does that make me a meddler?

lines.q: 你觉得我的样子……有什么奇怪的地方吗？我不想引人注目。
lines.en: Do you detect anything… strange about how I look? I don't want to stand out.

lines.q: 我的女儿正在长眠。希望她醒来时，我能在她身边。
lines.en: My daughter is currently in a long slumber. I hope to be at her side by the time she awakens.

lines.q: 别看我这样，我心里挂念的事比大多数人都多。能在你身边歇一会儿吗？
lines.en: Despite appearances, I carry more concerns than most people. Could I rest at your side awhile?

lines.q: 鞑古扎这片土地充满了有趣的东西。和你一起探索一定很有意思。
lines.en: The land of Dagda is full of interesting things. It'd be fascinating to explore it with you.

lines.q: 你这一身洁白让我想起一个与我非常亲近的人。让我靠近点看看。
lines.en: Your white appearance reminds me of someone very close to me. I'd like a closer look.

lines.q: 你在人身边很镇定呢。你不怕比你大的生物吗？
lines.en: You're quite calm around humans. Aren't you afraid of creatures bigger than you?

lines.q: 我们的使命、村民的期望……都很重要，但保护家人也一样重要，对吧？
lines.en: Our mission, the hopes of the villagers… It's all important, but so is protecting family, right?

lines.q: 我完全不知道鸟吃什么。改天能让我尝尝你的饭吗？
lines.en: I have no idea what birds eat. Maybe you could let me try one of your meals sometime?

lines.q: 我总是被比我年长的人吸引。我的初恋就是那样。所以才忘不掉吗？
lines.en: I'm always drawn to people older than me. My first love was like that. Is that why I can't forget them?

lines.q: 在外面的世界旅行有时很美好，但有时也会害怕。
lines.en: It can be wonderful traveling the outside world. But it does get scary sometimes.

lines.q: 你的眼睛好迷人。不知道在你看来，我的眼睛是什么样子？
lines.en: Your eyes are so charming. I wonder how mine look to you?

lines.q: 我喜欢照顾别人。改天能让我帮你梳理羽毛吗？
lines.en: I love taking care of others. Do you think I could preen your feathers sometime?

lines.q: 要是我留在村里，现在或许已经抱着孩子了。
lines.en: If I'd remained in the village, I could be holding a baby in my arms.

lines.q: 你从天上看过这个世界。真希望我会说鸟语，你一定有很多故事。
lines.en: You've seen the world from up in the sky. I wish I spoke bird language. I bet you have a lot of stories.

lines.q: 和神殿的人说话时我总有点戒备。你呢？
lines.en: I'm always a little wary of talking to people from the temples. What about you?

lines.q: 当佣兵其实没那么难。飞过战场的话，说不定能看到他们打仗！
lines.en: It's not too hard to be a merc, really. Fly over a battlefield, and maybe you'll see some in action!

lines.q: 爱打听的人真让我受不了。你懂我的意思吧？
lines.en: Nosy people drive me up the wall. You know what I mean?

lines.q: 我祖上来自达马斯卡，不代表我也信奉尤法斯。
lines.en: Just because my ancestors were from Damascar doesn't mean I pray to Yu Phas too.

lines.q: 要是能从一个战场飞到另一个战场？老兄，那才叫生活。
lines.en: Now, if I could fly from battlefield to battlefield? Man, that would be the life.

lines.q: 你真是个怪家伙，对吧？想活得久的动物通常都更小心。
lines.en: You're a strange one, aren't you? An animal that cares about living longer is usually more careful.

lines.q: 会飞的话，偷袭大概更容易吧？只要附近没有弓箭手。
lines.en: Launching a surprise attack is probably easier if you can fly, huh? As long as no archers are around.

lines.q: 有时候就算不在战场上，我也会觉得……浑身紧绷，你懂吧？
lines.en: Sometimes, even when I'm not on the battlefield, I feel this… tension in me, you know?

lines.q: 说起来，我一直喜欢雕小木像。也许哪天我会雕一个你。
lines.en: You know, I've always liked carving little wooden statues. Maybe, one day, I'll carve you.

lines.q: 你身体真健康，好像在哪儿都能活下去。
lines.en: You're in the pink of health. Like you could survive anywhere.

lines.q: 在战场上，好人总是死得最快。前一刻还在说笑，下一刻……就没了。
lines.en: In the field, nice guys always die fast. One minute, they're cracking jokes, and the next… they're gone.

lines.q: 我厌恶邋遢的男人，看到就心情变差。你有没有同样讨厌的东西？
lines.en: I detest shabby men. The sight of them sours my spirits. Is there something you similarly loathe?

lines.q: 大多数男人都嫉妒我。这也难怪。你看看我这模样？
lines.en: I'm envied by most men. Not that it's any wonder why. I mean, have you looked at me?

lines.q: 我是在一场冰雹中被遗弃在卡拉神殿的。所以你看到冰雹时，就想起我吧。
lines.en: It was during a hailstorm that I was left at Kalla's temple. So when you see hail, think of me.

lines.q: 鸟的乐器是啼鸣，而我对自己的乐器同样拿手。想听听吗？
lines.en: A bird's instrument is its chirp, but I'm no less skilled with my own. Would you like to hear?

lines.q: 论音乐造诣，我想我们一起合奏一曲会很愉快。你意下如何？
lines.en: Considering my own skill in music, I thought we might enjoy playing a song together. What say you?

lines.q: 我对自己的记忆力很有信心。就算在一群飞鸟中我也认得出你。
lines.en: I am confident in my memory. No doubt I could recognize you amidst a flock of winged creatures.

lines.q: 卡拉大人美得无法言喻。你应该亲眼瞻仰她有多么非凡。
lines.en: Kalla is too resplendent for words. You ought to admire for yourself what a marvel she is.

lines.q: 要像我这样融化人心，就得看遍世界的每一面。
lines.en: One must see the world in all its contours to melt others' hearts as I do.

lines.q: 卡拉大人赐给我的名字真是太棒了。你喜欢自己的名字吗？
lines.en: The name given to me by my lady Kalla is so excellent. Do you like your own name?

lines.q: 卡拉神殿的女性已经不再被我的诗打动了。我还能怎么追求她们呢？
lines.en: The women of Kalla's temple are no longer seduced by my poetry. What else could I do to woo them?

lines.q: 我饿极了的时候，你可别离我太近。很抱歉，你看起来真的很好吃。
lines.en: Be careful not to get too near me when I'm really hungry. You do look delicious, I'm sorry to say.

lines.q: 索雷尔大人很棒吧？他那么温柔、厉害，就是好得不得了！
lines.en: Don't you think Lord Solel is wonderful? He's so kind, amazing, and just plain great!

lines.q: 我从小就在爸爸和朋友们的宴会上大吃大喝。要是我办那样的大派对，你要来吗？
lines.en: I grew up enjoying food at my dad's feasts with his friends. If I have a big party like that, want to come?

lines.q: 我胃口超好。神殿给的薪水根本不够我吃饭。很惨吧？
lines.en: I have a VERY healthy appetite. The pay I get from the temple can't cover my meals. Tragic, right?

lines.q: 我喜欢给大家取可爱的小名。希望是可爱的啦。会不会有点怪？
lines.en: I like to give everyone cute little names. I hope it's cute anyway. Maybe it's kind of weird?

lines.q: 我最爱吃辣了。可惜总是一下就被吃光。这是为什么呢？
lines.en: I love spicy food more than anything. Too bad it always gets eaten up quick. Why is that, I wonder?

lines.q: 不管喝多少杯麦酒我都不会醉。你呢？
lines.en: I never get tipsy, no matter how many mugs of suds I drink. How about you?

lines.q: 我在里奥珊堡出生长大。你要是去那儿，可要当心那里的地痞！
lines.en: I was born and raised at Lyoshan Fort. If you ever go there, watch out for all the ruffians!

lines.q: 觉得谁可爱，我就忍不住给他取个有趣的名字。我要叫你「小鸟鸟」！
lines.en: If I think someone's cute, I can't help calling them a fun name. I'm going to call you Li'l Birdie!

lines.q: 嗯，烤的？炖的？啊！对不起，我没别的意思。你看起来一点都不好吃！
lines.en: Mmm, roasted? Braised? Oh! Sorry, I didn't mean anything by it. You don't look tasty at all!

lines.q: 我从你的眼睛里看到了智慧。我觉得我们会合得来！
lines.en: I can see such intelligence in your eyes. I think we could get along!

lines.q: 你的羽毛好漂亮。介意我凑近看看吗？
lines.en: You have such beautiful plumage. Do you mind if I take a closer look?

lines.q: 我好想变成鸟。我要从敞开的窗户直接飞进神殿的书库。
lines.en: I'd love to be a bird. I'd fly through the open windows and right into the temple library.

lines.q: 我喜欢躺着晒暖和的太阳。你也喜欢吗？
lines.en: I like to lie in the warm sun. Do you like it too?

lines.q: 这副眼镜很不错吧？是我爷爷传给我的。
lines.en: These glasses are pretty nice, don't you think? They're a hand-me-down from my grandfather.

lines.q: 技巧固然重要。但不懂其中的原理，就派不上多大用场。
lines.en: Technique is important, yes. But without knowledge of why it works, it won't be of much use.

lines.q: 我永远记得小时候和爷爷在一起，听吟游诗人唱了一首最动听的歌。
lines.en: I'll always remember being with Grandpa when I was little. We heard a bard sing the prettiest song.

lines.q: 我也许经验不足，但我努力学习，懂的比大多数人都多！
lines.en: I might be inexperienced, but I've studied hard and learned more than most people!

lines.q: 如果坏事无论如何都会发生，那抵抗还有意义吗？
lines.en: If something bad is going to happen no matter what, is there any point in fighting it?

lines.q: 想太多不好吧？脑袋会变得一团浆糊。
lines.en: It's bad to overthink things, isn't it? It makes your head go all fuzzy.

lines.q: （哈欠）好想打个盹。
lines.en: (yawn) I'm in the mood for some shuteye.

lines.q: 上了年纪也不妨碍在战场上称霸。你懂我的意思吧？
lines.en: Gettin' old doesn't stop a guy from dominating on the battlefield. You know what I'm saying?

lines.q: 喂，喝得稍微过量几杯没问题吧？
lines.en: Hey, is it a problem to go a few glasses past your limit?

lines.q: 我还能跟年纪只有我一半的人较量！
lines.en: I can still hold my own against anyone half my age!

lines.q: 我干活时喜欢唱歌，心情会变好。
lines.en: I like to sing when I work. Puts me in a good mood.

lines.q: 又来了！有人看见我就绕到街对面去。我长得真有那么吓人吗？
lines.en: It happened again! Some folks saw me and crossed the street. Am I really that scary-lookin'?

lines.q: 喝到睡着也不是什么坏事，对吧？
lines.en: It's not a bad thing to drink until you fall asleep, is it?

lines.q: 我最爱热闹的宴会了！真希望天天都有。
lines.en: Love a good party! I wish we could have one every day.

lines.q: 葡萄酒、蜂蜜酒、肉和鱼！这才叫一顿饱饭！
lines.en: Wine, mead, meat, and fish! That's what I call a full meal!

lines.q: 你看起来不太好吃。
lines.en: You look like you wouldn't taste so good.

lines.q: 钱我是存得下来，但我觉得它自己变多的可能性很低。
lines.en: I can save money, yes, but I feel like the odds are low that it'll start increasing on its own.

lines.q: 我觉得这个发型很好看。你觉得呢？
lines.en: I think this hairstyle is quite lovely. What do you think?

lines.q: 你觉得我将来会有一个幸福的家庭吗？
lines.en: Do you think I'll have a happy family in the future?

lines.q: 我发现了一件有意思的事。光是看着你，就让我格外平静。
lines.en: I've noticed something interesting. I find just looking at you to be unusually soothing.

lines.q: 我喜欢吃鱼，但总不能天天只吃鱼吧？
lines.en: I enjoy a good fish dinner, but you can't eat nothing but fish every day, can you?

lines.q: 有了喜欢的人，想让对方注意到自己时，你会怎么做？
lines.en: What do you do when there's someone you like and you want them to notice you?

lines.q: 吟游诗人的歌我能听一整天。他们的歌太动听了。
lines.en: I could listen to bards sing all day. Their songs are so lovely.

lines.q: 我觉得有时候就是忍不住要顶撞上司。
lines.en: I feel like sometimes there's just no avoiding snapping at your superiors.

lines.q: 你好可爱！可以带你回家吗？
lines.en: You're so cute! Can I take you home with me?

lines.q: 我最近累坏了。真想被人好好宠一宠……
lines.en: I've been so exhausted lately. I could really do with some pampering…

lines.q: 我知道我回不去了……可是……有时还是忍不住怀念失去的一切……
lines.en: I know I can't return home… But… sometimes I can't help but pine for what's gone…

lines.q: 在故乡，我过着东躲西藏的生活……可在鞑古扎，我能做自己。你喜欢这里吗？
lines.en: In my homeland, I lived a life of hiding… But in Dagda, I'm free to be myself. Do you like it here?

lines.q: 我受不了乱糟糟的桌子。只要有一点点乱，我就忍不住想收拾。
lines.en: I can't stand a messy desk. If it's just a little bit out of sorts, I get an overwhelming urge to clean it.

lines.q: 你看起来比一般的鸟聪明多了。要不要来商会当宠物？
lines.en: You seem far sharper than the average bird. How would you like to be a pet at the company?

lines.q: 说实话，我有时会对自己的嫉妒心感到很烦。真希望能控制得更好……
lines.en: To be honest, sometimes I get so annoyed at my own jealous feelings. I wish I could control them better…

lines.q: 你的羽毛真是太美了。也许哪天我能为你画一幅肖像。
lines.en: Your feathers are simply gorgeous. Perhaps, one day, I can draw your portrait.

lines.q: 喂……要是你看到我变成野兽，记住千万别靠近我，好吗？
lines.en: Hey… If you ever see me become a beast, remember that you mustn't approach me, alright?

lines.q: 我没法像读其他动物那样读出你的想法……你真的是鸟吗？
lines.en: I can't read your thoughts like other animals… Are you really a bird?

lines.q: 那时我因为纹章被人追杀，心想要是我是只鸟，也许就能飞走了。
lines.en: Back then, when I was being hunted for my crest, I thought if I was a bird, maybe I could just fly away.

lines.q: 谭利穆恩在很多方面都救过我。陪他胡闹只是小小的代价。
lines.en: Talimun has saved me in far more ways than one. Attending his misadventures is a small price to pay.

lines.q: 等我肉身消亡、化为灵魂飘浮时，我们一起在天上嬉戏吧。你说呢？
lines.en: When my body has perished, and I float as a soul, let's frolic in the sky. What do you say?

lines.q: 有句话说，飞出笼的鸟其实离家很近。你觉得对吗？
lines.en: There is a saying that a bird flown from the coop is truly still close to home. Does that sound right?

lines.q: 生或死……醉或醒……在这无常的世间都相差无几。你不同意吗？
lines.en: To live or die… To be tipsy or sober… These are similar states in a fleeting world. Don't you agree?

lines.q: 鸟鸣让一切都更美好，配上一杯好酒尤其相宜。你说是不是？
lines.en: Birdsong makes everything better. It pairs especially well with a fine drink. Wouldn't you say?

lines.q: 我听说有一种怪鸟，会把好好的酒变成毒酒。应该不是你吧？
lines.en: I've heard of a monstrous bird who turned perfectly good wine into poison. I trust that's not you?

lines.q: 我身上酒气熏天，你却不介意。你也喜欢微醺吗？
lines.en: I have the odor of hitting the bottles too heavily. Yet you don't mind. Do you enjoy a tipsy drink?

lines.q: 有人说信仰等于不思考。我不同意。不思考完全是另一回事。
lines.en: Some say that belief is the same as not thinking. I disagree. Not thinking is entirely different.

lines.q: 练习沉默是我修行的一部分。你要不要也试试？
lines.en: Practicing silence was part of my training. How about you give it a try?

lines.q: 如果鸟也有心，不知道你羽毛下跳动的是怎样一颗心。
lines.en: If birds have hearts, I wonder what kind beats under those feathers of yours.

lines.q: 看起来太危险的人就别去招惹，这主意不错。活得最久的人……才是赢家，对吧？
lines.en: Good idea not fighting anyone who looks too dangerous. Whoever lasts longest… wins, right?

lines.q: 有爹妈吗？要是没有，你跟我和兄弟们肯定合得来。你可以加入我们山贼团！
lines.en: Got parents? If you don't, you'd fit in with me and my pals just fine. You could join our bandit crew!

lines.q: 我以为靠抢和打什么都能到手。可我要怎样才能有个家呢……
lines.en: I thought I could get anything I want through plunder and fighting. But how can I get myself a family…

lines.q: 被抢被杀的人……是他们自己太弱！要我说，就该更拼命地打！
lines.en: If anyone gets robbed or snuffed out… they shouldn't be so weak! Fight harder, that's what I say!

lines.q: 打仗先挑弱的收拾是常识。在我看来你就是好下手的猎物！
lines.en: It's common sense to pick off the weaklings in battle. You look like easy prey to me!

lines.q: 大家都以为山贼只吃肉。我可是只吃蔬菜。记住了。
lines.en: People think bandits eat nothin' but meat. It's vegetables all the way with me. Keep that in mind.

lines.q: 我们在竞技会上一输，盖亚兵团那帮家伙就把我丢下等死。很残忍吧？
lines.en: The guys in the Gaia Brigade left me for dead as soon as we lost our battle in the games. Cruel, huh?

lines.q: 山就像我的家。我应该在山上给我和兄弟们盖座城堡，对吧？
lines.en: The mountains are like home to me. I should build me and my pals a castle up there, right?

lines.q: 现在可不能金盆洗手！你知道我干了多少年了吗？
lines.en: There's no way I can give up on pillaging now! You know how many years I've been at it?

lines.q: 像你这样的弱者最后都会变成晚餐。所以尽量飞高点，别被箭射中。
lines.en: Weaklings like you end up as dinner. So try to fly extra-high so the arrows don't get you.
